recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中多數細胞為核偏位、胞質深藍、核旁有淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，染色質呈車輪狀粗塊，另夾雜少數淋巴球與單核球樣細胞，屬於腦脊髓液漿細胞增多。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Distinct perinuclear clear zone (hof) in several cells
Mixed background of small lymphocytes and monocytoid cells; no neutrophil predominance in this field
Plasma cells appear mature without prominent nucleoli, binucleation or marked pleomorphism
describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a mononuclear pleocytosis with numerous mature-appearing plasma cells, characterized by eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof. Small lymphocytes and monocytoid cells are also present. No atypical plasmablasts, organisms or tumor cells are identified. Findings are consistent with CSF plasmacytosis, most often reactive to infection such as neurosyphilis, viral or bacterial meningitis; clinical correlation and, if persistent, flow cytometric light-chain assessment to exclude CNS myeloma are recommended.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Myelomatous plasma cells are often immature with nucleoli and pleomorphism and show light-chain restriction by flow cytometry or immunocytochemistry.
Bing-Neel shows a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P and a clonal IgM paraprotein.
Reactive lymphocytes have more central nuclei and lack the prominent hof and clock-face chromatin of plasma cells.
